filters.compensation: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_members h WHERE h.account = :requester) OR EXISTS (WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(employee) AS (SELECT manager FROM reporting_lines WHERE employee = compensation.employee UNION SELECT r.manager FROM reporting_lines r JOIN ancestors a ON r.employee = a.employee) SELECT 1 FROM ancestors a JOIN account_links l ON l.employee = a.employee WHERE l.account = :requester)
filters.personal_details: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_members h WHERE h.account = :requester) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM account_links l WHERE l.account = :requester AND l.employee = personal_details.employee)
filters.hr_notes: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_members h WHERE h.account = :requester)
